async def act(page):
    # Set the 'Period' combobox to 'Month' to get monthly aggregation
    period_combobox = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("combobox", name="Period")
    await period_combobox.select_option("Month")
    # Set the 'Order Status' combobox to 'Specified' to filter by status
    status_combobox = page.get_by_role("group", name="Filter").get_by_role("combobox", name="Order Status")
    await status_combobox.select_option("Specified")
    # Wait for the page to update after setting filters
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Look for a table or data rows to extract monthly order counts
    # First, check if there is a table on the page
    table = page.get_by_role("table").first
    if await table.is_visible():
        # Extract rows from the table
        rows = await table.get_by_role("row").all()
        data = []
        for row in rows:
            cells = await row.get_by_role("cell").all()
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                month = await cells[0].text_content()
                count = await cells[1].text_content()
                data.append(f"{month}:{count}")
        # Print the data as-is without any processing
        for item in data:
            print(item)
    else:
        # If no table, look for other data structures like lists or grids
        print("No table found. Data may be in a different format.")
